name: KM Freeport Lateral
monitor_reason: concrete step: no FID, permit, filing, or announcement is recorded; EIA itself says no activity in years and the cancelled status is assumed. Also intrastate with no regulator docket, so no second source. Length (40 mi) would pass the length rule.
researcher_notes: Only source is the EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects August 2026 release, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 1155 (last updated 2019-10-18). It lists a 40 mile, 30 inch, 320 MMcf/d lateral by Kinder Morgan Energy Partners in Texas, connecting the KM Tejas mainline to Stratton Ridge and Freeport LNG, type Lateral, intrastate, no authority or docket. EIA notes: no activity, filings, or announcements in years, so assumed cancelled. No concrete step is documented, so it fails the add-threshold. Not an existing GEM row: the Brazoria Interconnector, Freeport LNG Pipeline, Coastal Bend Header and P3666/P1297 are separate lines. Web search for a second source was not possible (session limit). Revisit only if an operator or Texas Railroad Commission record shows a real step. Owner not entity-checked because no row is staged.
